create_protein_from_prediction: create a Protein instance from model prediction features and output with optional b_factors and chain indices
create_protein_from_proteinnet_string: create a Protein instance by parsing a proteinnet string with PRIMARY, TERTIARY, and MASK tags
convert_protein_to_pdb_string: convert a Protein instance to a PDB-formatted string with proper atom coordinates and chain terminations
add_pdb_headers_to_protein: add PARENT and REMARK headers to an existing PDB string for multi-chain recycling
compute_ideal_atom_mask: compute an ideal atom mask for a Protein based on standard amino acid atom presence
